name: Chief Executive Officer
description: Leads the company, defines business strategy, and oversees overall company performance.

children.name: Managing Director
children.description: Directs company strategy, governance, and business performance.

children.name: Director
children.description: Provides strategic direction and oversees business functions or divisions.

children.name: General Manager
children.description: Manages overall operations, resources, and business performance.

children.name: Department Head
children.description: Leads a department, manages employees, and monitors departmental goals.

children.name: Manager
children.description: Plans, coordinates, and supervises a team or business function.

children.name: Assistant Manager
children.description: Supports the manager with daily operations, team coordination, and reporting.

children.name: Team Lead
children.description: Guides team members, assigns tasks, and monitors team performance.

children.name: Executive
children.description: Performs operational, administrative, or functional tasks within a department.

children.name: Officer
children.description: Handles departmental responsibilities, documentation, and process execution.

children.name: Assistant
children.description: Provides administrative and operational support to a team or manager.

children.name: Clerk
children.description: Maintains records, processes documents, and performs clerical duties.

name: Accountant
description: Maintains financial records and prepares accounts, reconciliations, and reports.

children.name: Chartered Accountant
children.description: Provides accounting, taxation, auditing, and financial compliance expertise.

name: HR Executive
description: Handles recruitment, employee documentation, onboarding, and HR administration.

children.name: Recruiter
children.description: Sources candidates, coordinates interviews, and supports hiring activities.

name: Sales Manager
description: Leads the sales team, manages sales targets, and develops customer relationships.

children.name: Assistant Sales Manager
children.description: Supports the sales manager in daily sales operations and team coordination.

children.name: Senior Sales Executive
children.description: Handles key accounts, supports junior sales executives, and manages important customer relationships.

children.name: Sales Executive
children.description: Generates leads, communicates with customers, and handles sales activities.

name: Marketing Executive
description: Executes marketing campaigns, promotions, branding, and lead-generation activities.

name: Purchase Executive
description: Processes purchase requests, obtains quotations, and coordinates with suppliers.

name: Storekeeper
description: Maintains stock records and manages the receipt, storage, and issue of goods.

children.name: Warehouse Supervisor
children.description: Supervises warehouse staff, stock handling, storage, and dispatch operations.

name: Production Engineer
description: Improves manufacturing processes and supports production planning and execution.

children.name: Production Supervisor
children.description: Supervises production workers and monitors output, schedules, and safety.

name: Quality Engineer
description: Develops quality processes and investigates product defects.

children.name: Quality Inspector
children.description: Inspects incoming materials, work in progress, and finished products.

name: Logistics Executive
description: Coordinates transportation, shipments, delivery schedules, and logistics documents.

name: Customer Support Executive
description: Responds to customer questions, resolves issues, and tracks service requests.

name: Software Engineer
description: Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications.

children.name: System Administrator
children.description: Maintains systems, user access, networks, servers, and IT infrastructure.

name: Administration Executive
description: Coordinates office facilities, supplies, records, and administrative services.

name: Legal Advisor
description: Advises on legal matters, reviews contracts, and supports regulatory compliance.

name: Project Manager
description: Plans project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, and delivery.

name: Research Engineer
description: Conducts technical research, experimentation, and product development.

name: Service Engineer
description: Installs, diagnoses, repairs, and maintains equipment or technical systems.

name: Internal Auditor
description: Evaluates internal controls, business processes, and compliance with company policies.

name: Trainee
description: Learns job responsibilities through supervised training and practical work.

name: Intern
description: Gains practical experience by assisting with supervised departmental tasks.
